title: fix: use dedicated Cloudflare token for traffic sync
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Uses a read-only Cloudflare token scoped to the pollinations.ai zone for the traffic sync.
- Leaves the shared deployment token and deploy workflows unchanged.
- Verified the new token can query Cloudflare GraphQL analytics for the zone.

gist.headline: A key for the numbers
gist.blurb: Cloudflare traffic sync now has its own read-only key for the pollinations.ai zone. The deployment key gets to keep doing its day job.
gist.summary: The Cloudflare traffic sync workflow now uses a dedicated read-only token scoped to the pollinations.ai zone, verified against Cloudflare GraphQL analytics, while deployment workflows remain unchanged.
gist.impact: Traffic sync can query zone analytics with its own scoped token; deployments continue using the existing token.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the traffic sync as a small garden analytics station with a chart on a CRT monitor and its own labeled key; a separate deployment workstation remains undisturbed. Polli tends the analytics station while the monitor robot points out the chart.
